usage: 蝦 (shrimp) is commonly used as a noun to refer to the small crustacean found in water.
It can be used alone or combined with other words to specify types or preparations of shrimp.
蝦 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
It is often used in everyday conversation about food, cooking, and animals.
